how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-20.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:92744:obj:0: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of .
rows.quest:92744:details:0: The corruption affecting ⟦E1⟧'s crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom ⟦E2⟧ to famine.
rows.quest:92744:details:1: Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
rows.quest:92745:obj:0: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
rows.quest:92745:details:0: The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
rows.quest:92745:details:1: The Defias have seized the mines of and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
rows.quest:92747:obj:0: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
rows.quest:92747:details:0: Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.
rows.quest:92747:details:1: I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of , but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?
rows.quest:92747:details:2: Please travel to Moonbrook, , and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
rows.quest:92748:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to the Dwarven District in ⟦E2⟧ and find an engineer who can help.
rows.quest:92748:details:0: The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of . We need to stop it, quickly.
rows.quest:92748:details:1: Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of ⟦E2⟧, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
rows.quest:92749:obj:0: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:92749:details:0: Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
rows.quest:92750:obj:0: Talk to someone in ⟦E2⟧ Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
rows.quest:92750:details:0: I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
rows.quest:92750:details:1: I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at ⟦E2⟧ Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
rows.quest:92751:obj:0: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:92751:details:0: You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in ⟦E2⟧'s lands.
rows.quest:92751:details:1: If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below ⟦E1⟧, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator - it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
rows.quest:92751:details:2: Oh - and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
rows.quest:92752:details:0: That's it - the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
rows.quest:92753:obj:0: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
rows.quest:92753:details:0: The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
rows.quest:92753:details:1: I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
rows.quest:92819:details:0: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
rows.quest:93552:obj:0: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:93552:details:0: Windstones are a critical resource on ⟦E4⟧ as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.
rows.quest:93552:details:1: You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?
rows.quest:93680:obj:0: Acquire the ⟦E5⟧ Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:93680:details:0: The ⟦E6⟧ had an army of mages known as the Kirin ⟦E7⟧. While they were powerful, the demonic ⟦E8⟧ proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.
rows.quest:93680:details:1: That is, until they rebuilt ⟦E5⟧. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!
rows.quest:93680:details:2: While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
rows.quest:93746:obj:0: Confront Belthaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
rows.quest:93746:details:0: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.
rows.quest:93746:details:1: Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
rows.quest:94414:obj:0: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
rows.quest:94414:details:0: Greetings, young . I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.
rows.quest:94414:details:1: They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.
rows.quest:94414:details:2: If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
rows.quest:94427:obj:0: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:94427:details:0: A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.
rows.quest:94427:details:1: Go to the ⟦E9⟧ and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
rows.quest:94434:obj:0: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:94434:details:0: Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?
rows.quest:94434:details:1: Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.
rows.quest:94434:details:2: Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
rows.quest:94435:obj:0: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:94435:details:0: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, paladin.
rows.quest:94436:obj:0: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:94436:obj:1: Should you misplace your :Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
rows.quest:94436:details:0: It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.
rows.quest:94436:details:1: The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.
rows.quest:94436:details:2: Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the ⟦E10⟧ what a true paladin can do.
rows.quest:94438:obj:0: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to ⟦E11⟧ Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:94438:obj:1: Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
rows.quest:94438:obj:2: *Take the Symbol of Life and use it to ⟦E11⟧ Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:94438:details:0: Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on ⟦E12⟧. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.
rows.quest:94438:details:1: Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to ⟦E12⟧. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.
rows.quest:94438:details:2: Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
rows.quest:94440:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E13⟧ Attack Plans from the ⟦E14⟧ Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
rows.quest:94440:details:0: These ⟦E14⟧ Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.
rows.quest:94440:details:1: You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
rows.quest:94441:obj:0: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Tyr's Watch.
rows.quest:94441:details:0: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.
rows.quest:94441:details:1: You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the ⟦E10⟧. Dark Lady watch over you, .
rows.quest:95161:obj:0: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:95161:details:0: If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in ⟦E15⟧. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.
rows.quest:95161:details:1: If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
rows.quest:95189:obj:0: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:95195:obj:0: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to ⟦E17⟧ in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:95204:obj:0: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:95216:obj:0: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:95216:details:0: Welcome to the most vital organ of the ⟦E9⟧: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of ⟦E18⟧'s exotic specimens.
rows.quest:95216:details:1: You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!
rows.quest:95216:details:2: I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
rows.quest:95250:obj:0: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
rows.quest:95250:details:0: What do you want, ? Can't you see there is a war to be won?
rows.quest:95250:details:1: My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.
rows.quest:95250:details:2: I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
rows.quest:95314:obj:0: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:95314:details:0: Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.
rows.quest:95314:details:1: I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. ⟦E3⟧ to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
rows.quest:95494:obj:0: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the .
rows.quest:95494:details:0: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.
rows.quest:95494:details:1: The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
rows.quest:95495:obj:0: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the .
rows.quest:95495:details:0: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.
rows.quest:95495:details:1: Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
rows.quest:95507:title: Vrang's Game
rows.quest:95507:obj:0: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the .
rows.quest:95507:details:0: While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.
rows.quest:95507:details:1: Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
rows.quest:95507:completion:0: Thank you for your aid, ⟦1⟧. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
rows.quest:95508:obj:0: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
rows.quest:95508:details:0: Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took ⟦E20⟧ and started his campaign in ⟦E21⟧, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.
rows.quest:95508:details:1: There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?
rows.quest:95508:details:2: There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
rows.quest:95621:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
rows.quest:95621:details:0: This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.
rows.quest:95621:details:1: If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
rows.quest:95646:obj:0: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:95646:details:0: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.
rows.quest:95646:details:1: The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.
rows.quest:95646:details:2: Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
rows.quest:95647:obj:0: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
rows.quest:95647:obj:1: * Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman
rows.quest:95647:details:0: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.
rows.quest:95647:details:1: But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!
rows.quest:95647:details:2: If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
rows.quest:95663:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to the ⟦E22⟧ and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
rows.quest:95663:details:0: The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.
rows.quest:95663:details:1: They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the ⟦E22⟧. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.
rows.quest:95663:details:2: A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
rows.quest:95664:obj:0: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in ⟦E23⟧ and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
rows.quest:95664:details:0: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:95682:obj:0: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
rows.quest:95682:details:1: The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?
rows.quest:95682:details:2: Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.
rows.quest:95682:details:3: If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
rows.quest:95697:obj:0: Enter the Excavation Sites in the and bring back Thicket ⟦E24⟧ Meat.
rows.quest:95697:details:0: Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
rows.quest:95697:details:1: If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.
rows.quest:95697:details:2: Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in ⟦E25⟧! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.
rows.quest:95697:details:3: A hunter recently came back from the ⟦E22⟧ with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.
rows.quest:95772:obj:0: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
rows.quest:95772:details:0: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the ⟦E22⟧ with some diggin' crew out o' ⟦E26⟧. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.
rows.quest:95772:details:1: Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.
rows.quest:95772:details:2: Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.
rows.quest:95772:details:3: If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
